entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex. I need to return my VeloBand GPS Tracker. It's not working properly.
I'm sorry to hear you're having trouble with it. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's a technical fault. The pulse rate is wildly inaccurate. I compared it to my old monitor and this new band is basically garbage.
I understand your frustration. An accurate pulse reading is crucial. Before we discuss a return, would you be open to trying a quick software calibration? It often resolves sensor inaccuracies.
I appreciate the offer, but I really don't have time to go through a bunch of steps. I just want money back for a product that doesn't work as advertised. I'd like to start the process for a refund.

I understand completely. You want a product that works right out of the box. Let me pull up your order information and review the return eligibility. Can I get your order number or the email address you used for the purchase?

Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see your order. It was delivered 17 days ago, on December 15th. Let me just check our policy... Yes, according to my knowledge base, all items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery.
Since you are well within that 90-day window, I can absolutely process this return for you. I'm sending a pre-paid return label to the email on file right now.
Oh, perfect. That's much easier than I expected. Thank you for your help.

You're very welcome. You should see that email within the next 5 to 10 minutes. Once we receive the item, the refund will be processed back to your original payment method. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thanks again, Alex.
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
